INDIGOTAILOR-RUSTED_BRASS_THIMBLE.title: Rusted Brass Thimble
INDIGOTAILOR-RUSTED_BRASS_THIMBLE.descri: At the start of turn 1 in each combat, add 1 Needle Embryo and 1 Cloth Embryo to hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-RUSTED_BRASS_THIMBLE.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-GOLDEN_AURA_THIMBLE.title: Golden Aura Thimble
INDIGOTAILOR-GOLDEN_AURA_THIMBLE.descrip: Replaces Rusted Brass Thimble. At start of turn, add 1 random upgraded Embryo+ to hand; all Embryos in hand gain Retain.
INDIGOTAILOR-GOLDEN_AURA_THIMBLE.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-NOTCHED_TAILOR_CHALK.title: Notched Tailor Chalk
INDIGOTAILOR-NOTCHED_TAILOR_CHALK.descri: The first time you [aqua]Stitch[/aqua] each turn, gain 4 Block.
INDIGOTAILOR-NOTCHED_TAILOR_CHALK.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-CRIMSON_PLUM_PINCUSHION.des: At the start of each combat, apply 2 [aqua]Unravel[/aqua] to ALL enemies.
INDIGOTAILOR-CRIMSON_PLUM_PINCUSHION.fla: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-SILVER_SEAM_RIPPER.title: Silver Seam Ripper
INDIGOTAILOR-SILVER_SEAM_RIPPER.descript: Whenever you [aqua]Unpick[/aqua], draw 1 card and deal 4 damage to ALL enemies.
INDIGOTAILOR-SILVER_SEAM_RIPPER.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-TWO_HOLE_BRASS_BUTTON.title: Two-Hole Brass Button
INDIGOTAILOR-TWO_HOLE_BRASS_BUTTON.descr: Every 3 Embryos exhausted or stitched, gain 1 Energy (max once per turn).
INDIGOTAILOR-TWO_HOLE_BRASS_BUTTON.flavo: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-COARSE_HEMP_SPOOL.title: Coarse Hemp Spool
INDIGOTAILOR-COARSE_HEMP_SPOOL.descripti: Upon pickup, choose a card in your deck to gain Innate.
INDIGOTAILOR-COARSE_HEMP_SPOOL.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-UNDERDOCKS_TAILORING_SHEARS: Whenever you [aqua]Cut[/aqua] a card, deal 5 damage and apply 1 [aqua]Unravel[/aqua] to ALL enemies.
A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-DRESSMAKER_MANNEQUIN.title: Dressmaker Mannequin
INDIGOTAILOR-DRESSMAKER_MANNEQUIN.descri: At the end of your turn, gain 3 Block for each unplayed Embryo in hand.
INDIGOTAILOR-DRESSMAKER_MANNEQUIN.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-TWIN_SILVER_NEEDLES.title: Twin Silver Needles
INDIGOTAILOR-TWIN_SILVER_NEEDLES.descrip: Whenever you apply [aqua]Unravel[/aqua] or Weak to an enemy, apply 1 additional stack.
INDIGOTAILOR-TWIN_SILVER_NEEDLES.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-BROKEN_GIANT_SHEARS.title: Broken Giant Shears
INDIGOTAILOR-BROKEN_GIANT_SHEARS.descrip: At the start of your turn, gain 1 Energy. At the start of combat, shuffle 2 Tangled Hemp into your draw pile.
INDIGOTAILOR-BROKEN_GIANT_SHEARS.flavor: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
INDIGOTAILOR-TREADLE_REFURBISH_TABLE.des: At Rest Sites, you may Refurbish: remove 1 card permanently to stitch a patch into an adjacent card in your deck.
INDIGOTAILOR-TREADLE_REFURBISH_TABLE.fla: A relic from the Fate-weaving workshop, with faint cyan silk entwined around its stitches.
